# sendgrid_partner_offerings (Data Source)

Retrieves the catalog of package and add-on offerings available to assign to partner accounts via `sendgrid_partner_account`. Requires a partner-tier API key.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "sendgrid_partner_offerings" "available" {}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Always `partner_offerings`.
- `offerings` (Attributes List) The available offerings. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--offerings))

<a id="nestedatt--offerings"></a>
### Nested Schema for `offerings`

Read-Only:

- `name` (String) The offering's name.
- `quantity` (Number) The offering's quantity, where meaningful.
- `type` (String) The offering type: `package` or `addon`.
